Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: character reference sheet for a project of the Olympuz family, binding for every later frame
Primary request: one wide sheet that fixes the figure of Koios once and for all, so he can be reproduced identically in every later scene of this project.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column. He is a large, finely carved monumental marble figure with real weight, not a small smooth figurine on a pedestal.
Subject: Koios, the titan of intellect and questioning whose second name is Polos, the axis the sky turns on, as a white-marble sculpture, shown four times in one row at the same height and the same scale: front view, three-quarter view turned to his left, full profile facing left, and back view. Beside the row, four larger attribute studies: the axis rod alone, the open marble ledger alone, the gold pin alone, and the head alone in three-quarter view.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right as the family signature, clearly separated from the figures. The four views stand in one straight row across the middle of the frame with equal spacing, each fully inside the frame with clear space above the head and below the base. The four attribute studies sit in a lower band under the row. That band ends well above the bottom edge: the lowest tenth of the image height is empty ivory ground with nothing in it at all. Every study, the head study included, stands complete inside the frame with that empty strip below it. The head study is a bust cut at the chest, and the whole bust including the chest is inside the frame. A study touched or cut by any edge of the frame is the single worst error in this sheet and makes the sheet unusable. Generous empty ivory space, nothing overlapping, nothing cropped.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble sculpture render, monumental carving with a real cornice profile and deep drapery, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation, museum plate feeling
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and welcoming, identical lighting on every view. The gold rod and the gold pin glow softly FROM WITHIN, as if lit by their own material; they are never lit by a lamp, a neon tube or a hard rim light, and no surface is left flat and dead.
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for the axis rod and the pin only, glowing softly along their edges as if lit from within, sky blue #B8D6EA for the incoming paths only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints, and these are the identity of the figure and must be identical in all four views:
- He is a mature bearded man with a short carved beard and hair bound by one plain flat marble fillet across the brow. His head is UNCOVERED: no veil, no hood, no helmet, no crown, no laurel.
- His eyes are open, level and attentive. He wears NO blindfold and nothing crosses his eyes.
- In every view his head is turned slightly away from his body, the questioning turn: he looks at the ledger in his left hand rather than straight ahead. The same turn, the same angle, in all four views.
- A classical chiton to mid-calf with a himation draped over the left shoulder and across the back, carved with deep folds and real thickness. One belt at the waist, at the same height in every view. He is barefoot, both feet flat on the ground.
- He HOLDS the axis rod in his right hand: a slender muted-gold rod as tall as his shoulder, its lower end resting on the ground beside his right foot and casting a shadow, his fingers closed around the shaft. One plain smooth marble ring encircles the rod near its top, loose around it like a hoop on a pole. The rod is straight and unadorned: NO snakes, NO wings, NO letters, NO carving, NO sun disc, NO lightning.
- He HOLDS the open marble ledger in his left hand: a thick white-marble book lying open on his upturned left palm at waist height, its two flat pages turned slightly toward the viewer. Each page carries exactly THREE carved horizontal grooves and nothing else: no letters, no digits, no emblem.
- One muted-gold pin is driven straight THROUGH the right-hand page of the open ledger, entering the face of the page and standing upright out of it, its plain flat head above the page and its point below. It pierces the page; it never rests on top of it and never floats above it.
- Three thin sky-blue paths run along the ground from the left edge of the frame and CONVERGE at the lower end of the axis rod. They lie flat on the ground, touch it along their whole length, and end at the rod; they never rise into the air.
- He stands on a round marble base whose full underside rests on the ground.
- Every view shows the same person wearing the SAME costume: one chiton, one himation over the same shoulder, one belt at the same height, one fillet across the brow. The rod shown alone in the study below is the SAME OBJECT he holds: same length, same single plain ring. The ledger shown alone is the same book with the same three grooves on each page and the same pin driven through it. Nothing changes between views except the angle of the camera.
- Anatomically correct hands with exactly five fingers, natural finger lengths and one clearly readable thumb, fingers not fused.
- Nothing hovers, nothing balances on a point: everything carried is held by a closed hand or an open palm, everything standing rests on a surface and casts a shadow.
- Preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: rainbow of many colors, prismatic colors, veil, hood, helmet, crown, laurel, blindfold, closed eyes, scales, sword, spear, owl, hearth, fire, flame, lightning bolt, sun disc, wings, globe, armillary sphere, telescope, floating rod, floating ledger, floating pin, a pin lying on the page instead of piercing it, a small smooth featureless figurine, a flat gradient block instead of carved marble, dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, extra or missing fingers, fused fingers, callout labels
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits, no measurement marks, no callout labels anywhere in the image.
